status: primary-source shortlist; no weights downloaded; no local VLM benchmark
scope: Offline Arabic forensic image/video reporting while detection runs on a 12 GB RTX 3060

recommendation.rationale: The 2B release has a smaller published weight footprint and a native vision encoder. It is the lower-memory first experiment, not a verified Arabic reporting solution. Compare against the mature 2B vision-language family before adopting a new runtime.
recommendation.not_selected: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct for a default redistributed product because its repository uses the Qwen Research License, not Apache-2.0.

models.vision: Official card describes a language model with a vision encoder and image/video usage.
models.languages: Family card reports 201 languages/dialects. No Arabic forensic-report quality result was located in this bounded review.
models.mode: Non-thinking default on the 2B model; suitable for bounded factual summaries as an experiment.

models.caution: The marketing name is 4B; the Hub total-size display rounds to 5B parameters. Two published BF16/F32 weight shards total about 9.32 GB. Do not estimate VRAM using the model name alone.
models.inference: Unquantized shared-GPU use has materially less headroom than 2B. Quantized fit and latency must be measured; disk size is not peak runtime VRAM.

models.role: Comparison baseline for visual grounding and Arabic report generation, using the same prompts/evidence as 3.5-2B.
models.limitations: Official card reports video support and 32-language OCR, but neither establishes Arabic forensic accuracy on this project. Card examples contain historical package-install guidance; verify current pinned runtime compatibility instead of blindly running source-install commands.

models.license_evidence: The official LICENSE limits the grant to non-commercial research/evaluation and directs commercial users to request a license.
models.technical_note: Official card supports bounded image resolution through min_pixels/max_pixels. It remains a technical comparison option if use complies with its license.

runtime_findings.finding: Current Transformers documentation exposes Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration plus a processor for multimodal use. The causal-language-only class omits image/video input.

Official bitsandbytes documentation lists Windows NVIDIA CUDA support and NF4/FP4 support on Pascal or newer. This makes Windows RTX 3060 quantization plausible; it does not certify this model/runtime combination or its peak memory.
Offline loading requires a previously cached complete model/processor/tokenizer snapshot. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 prevents Hub HTTP calls; local_files_only=True selects cached files.

proposed_experiment_not_implemented.resource_policy: One queued report at a time. Begin with 2-4 locally stored evidence frames, bounded image resolution, short context (for example 4096 tokens), and a bounded Arabic output. Keep detection prioritized and cancel/defer report work if the measured reserved-VRAM budget is exceeded.
measurements: Peak allocated/reserved GPU memory with detection active
Detection throughput and p95 stage latency with/without generation
Arabic factual precision and unsupported claims against independently labeled clips
Network-disabled model reload and complete report generation
proposed_experiment_not_implemented.memory_interpretation: Published weight bytes exclude KV cache, activations, vision preprocessing, CUDA allocator overhead, and other resident models. No fixed memory or generation-time promise is justified from this research.
proposed_experiment_not_implemented.safety_boundary: Generated text summarizes verified event evidence; it must not become a detection/confirmation signal. Require explicit uncertainty for unobservable identity, motive, weapon subtype, and scene details.

current_source_observation.fact: The inspected existing remote reporter defaults to deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1 via OPENROUTER_MODEL. That is not evidence of an installed offline visual model.
